long_biography.plain_text:
Malhas emerged publicly in Dubai real estate as developer and partner of Le Rêve, the 52-storey residential tower in Dubai Marina. His comments during its post-handover period stressed long-term asset management, technical operations and maintaining a development's brand, signalling an approach centred on the life of a building after completion.

He now leads Xtreme Vision, whose deliberately limited residential portfolio favours highly finished, low-density projects over volume. The firm followed Le Rêve with Volante, a 35-storey tower containing 45 apartments beside the Dubai Canal. Beyond development, Malhas and his wife, Hala Jayousi-Malhas, have supported Ramallah Friends School; she organised fundraising events in Dubai, and the school acknowledged their sustained assistance to Palestinian education.
